claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Flurbiprofen is a non-cytotoxic NSAID that inhibits COX-1/COX-2 and gamma-secretase at high micromolar concentrations, but at 2.5 uM over 5 days it is not expected to kill cancer cells.
